newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hypo-bank buys majority stake in Brau and Brunnen.
newsitem.headline: Hypo-bank buys majority stake in Brau and Brunnen.

text.p: Bavarian bank Bayerische Hypo-Bank said on Thursday that it plans to purchase 24.8 percent of the brewing and drinks group Brau und Brunnen from fund managers Porta Vermoegensverwaltung GmbH.
The purchase of the stake will increase Hypo-Bank's share in Brau und Brunnen from a current level of 33.6 percent to a controlling stake in the company.
The bank said it planned to sell on its stake at a later stage.
The purchase of the stake is planned to take place this year and is subject to approval by the German cartel office, Hypo Bank said in a statement.
Hypo-Bank owns 50 percent of Porta, with the other 50 percent held by Wood Gundy SA in Geneva.
Shares in Brau und Brunnen were suspended earlier on Thursday.

Hypo-Bank said in an ad-hoc statement that it had said previously that it did not have any intention of running Brau und Brunnen as a subsidiary and said it did not rule out selling the company on to an individual partner.
